import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        int[][] P = new int[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                P[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(parts[j]);
            }
        }
        Map<BitSet, FieldMod> G = new HashMap<>();
        G.put(new BitSet(), new FieldMod(1));
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            Map<List<Integer>, FieldMod> H = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<BitSet, FieldMod> g : G.entrySet()) {
                BitSet key = g.getKey();
                List<Integer> S = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int m = 0; m < (1 << N); ++m) {
                    if (key.get(m)) {
                        S.add(m);
                    }
                }
                H.put(S, g.getValue());
            }
            G.clear();
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); ++j) {
                FieldMod pst = new FieldMod(1);
                for (int k = 0; k < N; ++k) {
                    if (((j >> k) & 1) == 1) {
                        pst = pst.multiply(new FieldMod(P[i][k]));
                    } else {
                        pst = pst.multiply(new FieldMod(100 - P[i][k]));
                    }
                }
                for (Map.Entry<List<Integer>, FieldMod> h : H.entrySet()) {
                    BitSet ans = new BitSet();
                    for (int l = 0; l < N; ++l) {
                        if (((j >> l) & 1) == 0) continue;
                        for (int m : h.getKey()) {
                            if (((m & (1 << l))) == 0) {
                                int mOr = m | (1 << l);
                                ans.set(mOr);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (ans.cardinality() > 0) {
                        G.put(copyBitSet(ans), h.getValue().multiply(pst));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        FieldMod ans = new FieldMod(0);
        for (Map.Entry<BitSet, FieldMod> g : G.entrySet()) {
            ans = ans.add(g.getValue());
        }
        int totalDivisions = N * N;
        for (int i = 0; i < totalDivisions; ++i) {
            ans = ans.divide(new FieldMod(100));
        }
        out.println(ans);
        out.flush();
    }

    private static BitSet copyBitSet(BitSet original) {
        BitSet copy = new BitSet();
        copy.or(original);
        return copy;
    }
}

class FieldMod {
    private static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    private long v;

    public FieldMod(long v) {
        this.v = ((v % MOD) + MOD) % MOD;
    }

    public FieldMod add(FieldMod other) {
        return new FieldMod((this.v + other.v) % MOD);
    }

    public FieldMod subtract(FieldMod other) {
        return new FieldMod((this.v - other.v + MOD) % MOD);
    }

    public FieldMod multiply(FieldMod other) {
        return new FieldMod((this.v * other.v) % MOD);
    }

    public FieldMod divide(FieldMod other) {
        return this.multiply(other.inverse());
    }

    public FieldMod inverse() {
        return new FieldMod(modInverse(this.v, MOD));
    }

    private static long modInverse(long a, long m) {
        long m0 = m, t, q;
        long x0 = 0, x1 = 1;
        if (m == 1) return 0;
        while (a > 1) {
            q = a / m;
            t = m;
            m = a % m; a = t;
            t = x0;
            x0 = x1 - q * x0;
            x1 = t;
        }
        if (x1 < 0) x1 += m0;
        return x1;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return String.valueOf(v);
    }
}
